metadata.title: The Dragon's Heir
metadata.description: In the kingdom of Valdris, you discover you carry dragon blood—a power that could save or destroy the realm. With civil war looming and ancient enemies awakening, your choices will shape the fate of millions.
metadata.author: Network Narrative Engine

characters.name: Princess Lyra
characters.description: Heir to the throne, torn between duty and justice. She sees potential in you.

characters.name: Kael the Shadowblade
characters.description: Leader of the rebellion, fights for the common folk. Distrusts all nobility.
characters.personality: Charismatic, ruthless when necessary, haunted by loss.

characters.name: Archdrake Vorn
characters.description: Ancient dragon who has watched empires rise and fall. He remembers the old pacts.
characters.personality: Patient, cryptic, amused by mortal concerns.

nodes.title: The Burning Village
nodes.preview: Your power awakens when soldiers attack your home.
nodes.description: Royal soldiers torch your village, hunting 'traitors.' As flames consume your home, something ancient stirs in your blood. Fire bends away from you. The soldiers freeze in terror.

nodes.title: The Royal Summons
nodes.preview: Discovered as a noble's secret child, you're brought to court.
nodes.description: Guards escort you to the throne room. Princess Lyra studies you with curious eyes. 'So you're the one,' she murmurs. 'The bloodline we thought extinct.'
In dreams, you soar over mountains. A voice like thunder speaks: 'Child of the old pact, your fire calls to me. Seek the Obsidian Peak.'
Lyra finds you alone. 'My father's gone mad with fear. He'll burn the kingdom to ash hunting dragon-blooded. But with your power, we could force peace.'
The Shadowblade intercepts you. 'The crown will use you then discard you. Join us. Your fire could free thousands from tyranny.'
Atop Obsidian Peak, ancient Vorn waits. His scales shimmer with starlight. 'Little flame,' he rumbles, 'your ancestors promised to guard this land. The pact remains unbroken.'
War erupts. Crown forces and rebels clash while ancient darkness stirs in the mountains. Both sides beg for your power. Vorn watches from above.
The true enemy reveals itself—shadow wyrms, corrupted dragons thought extinct. They care nothing for human politics. Only dragonfire can stop them.
The fate of Valdris hangs on your choice.

nodes.title: Fire and Dawn
nodes.description: Honoring the ancient pact, you unite humans and dragons against the shadow wyrms. Vorn leads the flight; you ride at his side, fire incarnate.
nodes.epilogue: Valdris enters a new age. Dragons return as guardians, not legends. Lyra reforms the kingdom while Kael ensures the people's voice is heard. And you? You become the bridge between worlds, the Dragon's Heir in truth.

nodes.title: The Dragon Queen
nodes.description: With your power backing the crown, the rebellion ends. Lyra takes the throne with you as her champion and, perhaps, something more.
nodes.epilogue: Peace comes, but at cost. The common folk whisper of tyranny wrapped in dragon scales. Lyra strives for justice, but change is slow. The shadow wyrms fade, for now. Vorn watches, waiting to see if humans deserve their second chance.

nodes.title: Fire of Freedom
nodes.description: Your flames shatter the old order. Kael leads the new council, and for the first time, common blood sits in halls of power.
nodes.epilogue: Revolution always has costs. Noble houses burn, some innocent among them. But schools open in villages that never had them. Lyra vanishes into exile. The shadow wyrms remain a threat, one the new Valdris must face without ancient alliances.

nodes.title: Kingdom of Ashes
nodes.description: Divided, Valdris falls. Shadow wyrms feast on the chaos. You survive, but rule only ruins.
nodes.epilogue: In the wasteland, survivors tell stories of what might have been. A dragon's heir who couldn't unite, a kingdom that burned itself before the enemy arrived. Vorn vanishes east. Perhaps somewhere, somehow, the cycle will begin again.
